newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: CS CEO says '97 starts good, but cautious.
newsitem.headline: CS CEO says '97 starts good, but cautious.

text.p: Credit Suisse's new chief executive Lukas Muehlemann said business got off to a good start this year, but cautioned that one could not assume the entire year would go as in January and February.
Muehlemann told a news conference the year got off to a good start "but one cannot assume that the entire year will go as well as the first two months."
Muehlemann noted that Switzerland was still in an economic recession. Although the weaker Swiss franc should have a positive effect, this was still in its early stage of having any impact.
Credit Suisse also expected "significant progress" in its Swiss business and also expects to continue structural improvements in other areas.
With respect to the entire year, Muehlemann said that "all in all from today's perspective we are confident -- very confident."
